name: CARsgen Therapeutics Holdings Limited
summary: CARsgen Therapeutics Holdings Limited, a biopharmaceutical company founded in Shanghai in 2014, discovers, develops and commercializes CAR-T cell therapies for blood cancers and solid tumors in China and the United States. Its autologous CAR-T candidates include CT053 for multiple myeloma, CT041 for gastric and pancreatic cancers, CT011 and CT017 for liver cancer, and CT032 for lymphoma. It is also developing AB011, a monoclonal antibody for CLDN18.2-positive tumors.
